atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent PNG character rigging sprite atlas for FurEver, a cozy pet simulator.
Input image 1 is a character identity and rendering-style reference only. Create a NEW organized game cutout atlas of this same enormous-eared cream-and-ginger fantasy kitten, bright teal eyes, pink nose, fluffy cream muzzle, and turquoise crystal pendant. It is a toy/game character.
Canvas: landscape 4:3, ideally 2048x1536. EXACTLY FOUR columns and THREE rows of equal square invisible cells. Every cell contains exactly ONE isolated part with genuine alpha transparency around it, no visible grid and no labels. Parts must never cross cell boundaries.
CRITICAL cell map, read left to right:
ROW 1: column 1 = front-facing neutral HEAD ONLY, open teal eyes and closed gentle smile; column 2 = same HEAD ONLY, happy eyes squeezed shut and smiling closed mouth; column 3 = same HEAD ONLY, blink with closed eyes and neutral closed mouth; column 4 = same HEAD ONLY, surprised open teal eyes and small O mouth.
ROW 2: column 1 = pear-shaped fluffy cream-and-ginger TORSO ONLY, turquoise pendant and neck stub, absolutely NO head, forelimbs, legs or tail; column 2 = isolated LEFT forelimb with paw, relaxed pointing down; column 3 = corresponding isolated RIGHT forelimb with paw, relaxed pointing down; column 4 = isolated long curved fluffy tail with cream tip.
ROW 3: column 1 = same HEAD ONLY, sleepy closed eyes relaxed mouth; column 2 = same HEAD ONLY, gleeful laugh closed eyes open smiling mouth; column 3 = isolated LEFT hindfoot; column 4 = isolated RIGHT hindfoot.
All SIX head variants must have exactly the same scale, front-facing position, enormous included ears, silhouette proportions and cell-centered alignment. Head centers at each cell center; head silhouettes occupy about 80% of each cell dimension with ample transparent margins. Torso and limbs centered with 60–70% cell fill. Cutout roots may be hidden under overlapping fur when assembled. Character rendering: polished soft volumetric 3D animated mobile game quality, warm soft fur, clean transparent alpha edges, identical lighting for every part, neutral front view. Keep parts fully separate.
Background: fully transparent alpha, not white and not a painted checkerboard. No ground shadow, no stage, no backdrop. No letters, numbers, lines, text, labels, watermark, UI, or extra objects. No complete body in any cell. No anatomical gore, just harmless fluffy toy/game cutout components.
sanctuary:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production wide game sanctuary interior background for FurEver, cozy pet simulator, 16:10 composition, ideally 1920x1200.
Input image 1 is a rendering-style and color reference ONLY; do NOT put that animal or any character in the output.
Create a cozy whimsical sanctuary interior EMPTY of characters. Warm cream plaster walls and soft carved wood architecture. A generous round window on the back wall reveals a teal moonlit woodland. A cushioned pet bed sits to the left. A leafy plant, a few books and small shelves sit on the right. Faint enchanting magical details, warm coral and amber lamp lighting, polished 3D animated family game style. Calm readable surfaces and low clutter.
Camera: pet eye height, front-facing medium-wide interior view. Keep broad clear central floor space and a broad soft warm rug open for a large articulated game pet that will be composited later. Central rug must remain unobstructed and fill the bottom center of the image. Let cozy furnishings frame the edges without covering the central play space.
Style: soft volumetric lighting, rounded tactile materials, warm pale peach and cream inside, deep turquoise teal outside, inviting polished game environment, believable depth.
No cats, pets, people, animals, characters, silhouettes, faces, UI, labels, text, icons, watermarks, or logo. No central furniture; broad clear empty playable center.
